screens.help: The voice changer (the operator's module): on / off for this phone, a preset or custom values, a test recording. $voiceFx: allowed (the module lets this user in), active (the voice is being changed now), testing (idle | recording | playing).

screens.help: A saved room changed (its row's swipe › Edit): the join form, filled — name, room, passphrase.

screens.label: Settings › Public profile
screens.help: The user's profile card: photo, background, public nickname (pre-fills the name when joining a room), about and fields — each only me / room members / public — with a preview per audience; saved sealed into the vault, its public part on the server.

screens.label: History (calls and messages)
screens.help: Calls and messages of every saved room, newest first: a filter (all / calls / messages / missed), a search, a tap opens the room, the phone button calls again after a confirmation. Sealed, hold-to-read, vanishing and hidden messages show only their kind.

screens.label: Message › sender's profile
screens.help: A tap on a sender's avatar: what they share with the room's members (their room profile), else the name and that they share nothing; a private message, their details.

screens.label: Message › forward
screens.help: Forward a message (a left swipe on its bubble, the long press, a file's footer): the message, the connected rooms, then everyone there or one person privately.
